run_diplomacy_training: run the diplom CLI to train a Diplomacy agent using any registered ParlAI task and model
run_order_prediction_task: run the diplom CLI with a state_order_chunk teacher to predict Diplomacy orders from board state
run_dialogue_generation_task: run the diplom CLI with a message_history_dialogue_chunk teacher to generate Diplomacy dialogue messages
run_lie_detector_task: run the diplom CLI with a liedetector_chunk teacher to classify whether Diplomacy messages contain lies
run_discriminator_task: run the diplom CLI with a discriminator teacher to classify real versus corrupted Diplomacy messages
